verdict.rationale: Clara publishes its own API reference (an api-reference section, per-endpoint pages, an LLM-optimized /llms-api.txt, and a probed live OpenAPI 3.1 schema documented for Postman import), backed by a sandbox for safe test calls. No evidence shows that reference is interactive or has in-page runnable examples; Postman is an external tool and earns no credit on its own. Missing for 10: a documented in-browser 'try it' console or playground, runnable code examples in the reference, and hands-on corroboration of interactivity.
